name: PowerToys
author: @S1LV4
description: Triggers Microsoft PowerToys utilities straight from the ring (Color Picker, Always On Top, FancyZones, Screen Ruler, Text Extractor, Peek…). Needs PowerToys installed: the plugin checks the installation and tells you when it or a module is not available.

actions.name: PowerToys · Color Picker
actions.description: Opens the PowerToys Color Picker to copy the color of any point on the screen.

actions.name: PowerToys · Always On Top
actions.description: Pins (or unpins) the active window above the others.

actions.name: PowerToys · Awake
actions.description: Shows whether Awake is keeping the computer awake. Clicking opens the Awake page in PowerToys settings (the plugin does not change settings).

actions.name: PowerToys · FancyZones Editor
actions.icon: <rect x='3' y='4' width='18' height='16' rx='2'/><path d='M12 4v16'/><path d='M12 12h9'/>
actions.description: Opens the FancyZones layout editor.

actions.name: PowerToys · Screen Ruler
actions.icon: <rect x='2' y='8' width='20' height='8' rx='1'/><path d='M6 8v3'/><path d='M10 8v4'/><path d='M14 8v3'/><path d='M18 8v4'/>
actions.description: Opens Screen Ruler to measure distances in pixels.

actions.name: PowerToys · Text Extractor
actions.description: Selects an area of the screen and copies the recognized text (OCR).

actions.name: PowerToys · Peek
actions.description: Previews the file selected in File Explorer (Explorer must be the active window).

actions.name: PowerToys · Shortcut Guide
actions.description: Shows the Windows keyboard shortcut guide.

actions.name: PowerToys · Find My Mouse
actions.description: Highlights where the mouse pointer is on the screen.

actions.name: PowerToys · Mouse Highlighter
actions.description: Turns mouse click highlighting on or off.

actions.name: PowerToys · Mouse Pointer Crosshairs
actions.description: Turns the crosshairs centered on the mouse pointer on or off.

actions.name: PowerToys · Mouse Jump
actions.icon: <rect x='2' y='5' width='9' height='7' rx='1'/><rect x='13' y='12' width='9' height='7' rx='1'/><path d='M8 16c1 3 4 3 5 0'/><path d='M11 14l2 2-3 1'/>
actions.description: Opens a thumbnail of the screens to jump the pointer to another monitor.

actions.name: PowerToys · Crop And Lock (thumbnail)
actions.description: Crops an area of the active window into a live thumbnail.

actions.name: PowerToys · Crop And Lock (reparent)
actions.description: Crops the active window, keeping it interactive inside a smaller window.

actions.name: PowerToys · Command Palette
actions.description: Opens the PowerToys Command Palette.

actions.name: PowerToys · PowerToys Run
actions.description: Opens the PowerToys Run launcher.

actions.name: PowerToys · Advanced Paste
actions.icon: <rect x='5' y='4' width='14' height='17' rx='2'/><rect x='9' y='2' width='6' height='4' rx='1'/><path d='M9 11h6'/><path d='M9 15h4'/>
actions.description: Opens Advanced Paste in the active window.

actions.name: PowerToys · Workspaces Editor
actions.icon: <rect x='3' y='3' width='8' height='8' rx='1'/><rect x='13' y='3' width='8' height='5' rx='1'/><rect x='13' y='10' width='8' height='11' rx='1'/><rect x='3' y='13' width='8' height='8' rx='1'/>
actions.description: Opens the Workspaces editor.

actions.name: PowerToys · ZoomIt (zoom)
actions.description: Turns on ZoomIt screen zoom.

actions.name: PowerToys · ZoomIt (draw)
actions.description: Turns on ZoomIt screen drawing.

actions.name: PowerToys · Light Switch
actions.description: Switches Windows between the light and dark theme.

actions.name: PowerToys · Settings
actions.description: Opens the PowerToys settings.
